feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 June 2026 10:38pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 17 June 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, then increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning. Often a force or two lighter in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreading from the west tomorrow morning, largely clearing during the afternoon, but with areas of mist and fog patches spreading from the south.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or mist, then very poor in fog patches later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, but 3 to 5 in the southeast of the area, falling 3 to 5 in all waters Friday evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight or moderate Friday evening.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, but a risk of mist and fog patches persisting. Rain arriving on Friday morning, tending to clear by the evening.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain or mist. Very poor in fog patches.
